1 قَمَشَ , aor.
فَمِشَ , (M, TA,) inf. n. قَمْشٌ, (S, M, K,) He collected (S, M, K) a thing, (S,) or قُمَاش, (M, K,) meaning small rubbish, or broken particles of things, on the surface of the ground, (K,) hence and thence; (S, TA:) as also ↓ قمّش , inf. n. تَقْمِيشٌ. (S, TA.) Hence, قَمْشُ الرِّيحِ التُّرَابَ [The wind's collecting the dust]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
